description: This Java class provides utility functions for generating random strings and names, obtaining the current date, and formatting double values conditionally. It's a helper utility class used in tests within the Fineract project.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A final utility class offering static methods for string generation, date retrieval, and number formatting.

methods.name: randomStringGenerator
methods.description: Generates a random string with a specified prefix, length, and character set.

methods.name: randomNameGenerator
methods.description: Generates a random name with a specified prefix and suffix length, using the default alphanumeric character set.

methods.name: now
methods.description: Returns the current date in UTC as a LocalDate.
